item.title: Snow expected as cold snap on the way
item.description: Start wrapping up, as a cold snap is on the way, according to Met Éireann. Temperatures are expected to dip as a polar air mass moves over the country from Friday. item.title: Cavan Women's Shed filled 85 Christmas boxes for poor kids
item.description: Cavan Women's Shed had a hugely successful shoebox appeal this year. It had 85 boxes filled with "love and beautiful gifts" collected and taken to the checking centre in Cootehill. They travel from there to Eastern Europe and Africa and the kindness and generosity will bring joy and hope to many children and families. item.title: Sharp drop in unemployment rate in Monaghan
item.description: The largest percentage decrease in the number of persons on the Live Register in the 12 months to November 2025 was seen in Co Monaghan. The difference throughout the months was a decrease of 5.3 per cent. Over 4,000 people were on the live register in Cavan and Monaghan up to the end of November Advertisement Figures from the CSO show 2,385 people were on the register in Cavan. item.title: Major power cut in Monaghan town, as some businesses close doors
item.description: Over 1,200 homes, farms and businesses around Monaghan town are without electricity. The ESB says the fault was recorded at around 12.30pm and they hope to have power back around 1.30pm. Sources say some businesses in Monaghan town have closed their doors. Advertisement Some ATMs have also been affected by the power cut.

item.title: Challenge people if they're drunk behind wheel - gardai
item.description: Gardai have appealed to people to prevent drink and drug-drivers getting behind the wheel during the busy New Year period. Roads around the country are expected to be particularly busy tonight and tomorrow. Almost 600 people have been arrested for being under the influence of cocaine, cannabis or alcohol in the month of December alone. item.title: Over 2,000 people admitted to Cavan hospital on trolleys this year
item.description: A total of 2,146 people have been admitted to Cavan hospital on trolleys this year. Over 114,000 patients, including more than 1,200 kids, were admitted to hospital without a bed around the country in 2025. In Our Lady of Lourdes Hospital in Drogheda, 3,509 people were admitted on trolleys.
